images.prompt:
Create ONE exquisitely detailed landscape educational reference image for a premium backend engineering learning service.
This is a fully developed precise technical learning scene, not an icon, pictogram, emoji, generic marketing illustration or decorative server collage.
Craftsmanship: high-DPI institutional engineering terminal, very fine matte navy glass surface, subtle micro-grain, restrained cyan and warm gold accents, crisp light text, perfectly aligned grid, disciplined line weights, calm density, substantial readable typography.
Composition: one coherent left-to-right diagram with large readable labels and a narrow explanatory status strip below; technical relationship and current state have priority. Keep all labels inside safe margins. No browser shell, no logos, no watermark, no fake measured telemetry, no green PASS badges. English typography only; do not invent source code or real hashes.
Output one opaque landscape image around 1672x941; final deliverable is converted to JPG at native resolution.
Scene: Title "Who changes the cluster in this GitOps model?" and a small clear badge "ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL - NO CLUSTER RUN". Four main columns: CI, Git declarations, Argo CD, Kubernetes. CI has "verify code / prepare artifact" and an arrow to Git labeled "commit desired revision R2". Git has "revision R2 / image D2". R2 and D2 are symbolic example identifiers, not real SHA or digest. Inside Argo CD, place a separate repo-server box above an application-controller box. An information-flow arrow from Git to repo-server reads "read revision / render manifests"; a downward arrow to application-controller reads "desired manifests". Between controller and cluster show two clearly separated paths: arrow from cluster to controller labeled "observe live state", arrow from controller to cluster labeled "apply when sync policy allows". Kubernetes shows "live resources / observed status". A lower strip compares two INDEPENDENT illustrative cases, not simultaneous stages: case A "OutOfSync + Healthy" with "desired version differs; current resources may be healthy"; case B "Synced + Progressing" with "desired spec matches; readiness may still be progressing". Important precise caption: "Sync and health are separate evaluations." Final short scope footer: "Controllers still need configured access. R2 / D2 are symbolic labels. No Git push, registry or cluster operation was performed." Keep the model diagram's labels readable at desktop size and do not add long paragraphs, tiny pseudo-text, fake logs or generic cloud icons.
